scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n web,desktop "npm -w web run dev" "npm -w desktop run dev"
scripts.dev:browser: concurrently -k -n web,server "npm -w web run dev" "npm -w desktop run dev:server"
scripts.build: npm -w web run build && npm -w desktop run build
scripts.start: npm run build && npm -w desktop run start
scripts.server: npm -w desktop run build:main && npm -w desktop run server
scripts.typecheck: npm -w web run typecheck && npm -w desktop run typecheck
